request.description: Original Pulp Wars chunky clean 2D strategy-game illustration, playful board-game sticker, strong dark colored outline, mostly flat colors, two-level cel shading, minimal texture, simple highlight, intentionally drawn rather than rendered, charming silly adventurous tone. Polished smooth 2D illustrated terrain resource on a transparent 256 by 384 canvas. Add exactly TWO tiny separate green seedlings growing from the top near center. Emphasize a generous wide soil surface, not roots or plants. Smooth flowing continuous ink outline, large flat two-tone shading, no small pixels or texture. Center inside the owning square; bottom at y324. It represents wild fertile ground before Farm construction. No ground outside this isolated patch.
